jax.numpy elementwise functions

Source: R/numpy_core.R, R/numpy_ufuncs.R
jnp_ufuncs.Rd

Ports of the jax.numpy ufuncs. Arguments broadcast with NumPy rules and are promoted with JAX type promotion.

jnp_ufuncs

Arguments

x, x1, x2

Arrays or R values.

decimals

Number of decimals.

out

Not supported (must be NULL).

Value

An array.

Details

jnp_ufuncs is a list of the jnp_ufunc() objects of jax.numpy (jnp_ufuncs$add is jnp.add): add, bitwise_and, bitwise_or, bitwise_xor, logaddexp, logaddexp2, logical_and, logical_or, logical_xor, maximum, minimum, multiply, negative and subtract. They have the methods reduce, accumulate, reduceat, outer and at, for example jnp_ufuncs$add$reduce(x). jnp_divmod(), jnp_frexp() and jnp_modf() return lists of two arrays.
